body:
## What it does

You answer a few questions once, then it looks back over a window you choose, one month, two or three, for work that was billed to nobody, subscriptions still quietly charging, and cash somebody owes you. Findings land in a table with a follow-up note drafted for each, and nothing leaves your outbox unapproved.

## Before you install

Open the share link and read the instructions it carries before you add it. @Andrew51786 shared this one publicly, and adding it copies the setup into your own account rather than giving you access to theirs.
